mapper.update: LOCK TABLE fin.mth_cls IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin.mth_cls(cls_ym) VALUES(#{month}) ON CONFLICT(cls_ym) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED' ORDER BY cls_ym
SELECT pl_src_cd FROM fin.mth_pl WHERE pl_ym=#{month}
SELECT user_nm FROM sys.user_info WHERE user_id=#{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}

WITH eligible AS ( SELECT d.dev_id FROM mst.dev d WHERE ((d.hire_dt IS NOT NULL OR d.rsgn_dt IS NOT NULL OR d.use_yn='Y') AND (d.hire_dt IS NULL OR d.hire_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month') AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt >= to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM'))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >= to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cst.mth_cst c WHERE c.dev_id=d.dev_id AND c.cst_ym=#{month}) ), monthly_bills AS ( SELECT b.* FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id WHERE CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN to_char(b.bill_dt,'YYYY-MM') ELSE b.atrb_ym END=#{month} ), operating_parts AS ( SELECT p.bsn_part_id FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.hq_yn='N' AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cst.mth_cst c WHERE c.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND c.cst_ym=#{month}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} WHERE d.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monthly_bills b JOIN prj.prj j ON j.prj_id=b.prj_id WHERE j.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL') OR (p.use_yn='Y' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev d JOIN eligible e ON e.dev_id=d.dev_id WHERE d.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id)) ) ), counts AS ( SELECT 'SALARY_UPLOAD'::text AS code,'FAIL'::text AS severity,count(*)::int AS count FROM eligible e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cst.mth_cst c WHERE c.dev_id=e.dev_id AND c.cst_ym=#{month}) UNION ALL SELECT 'MM_OVER','WARN',count(*)::int FROM ( SELECT a.dev_id FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE m.work_ym=#{month} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' GROUP BY a.dev_id HAVING sum(m.mm_qty)>1.00) over_mm UNION ALL SELECT 'DISPATCH_ATT','FAIL',count(*)::int FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.dev_id=a.dev_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} WHERE p.cntrct_ty_cd='DP' AND a.untprc_base_cd IN ('DAY','HOUR') AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >=to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM') AND (t.atnd_id IS NULL OR (a.untprc_base_cd='DAY' AND t.work_day_qty IS NULL) OR (a.untprc_base_cd='HOUR' AND t.rglr_tm_qty IS NULL)) UNION ALL SELECT 'BILL_UNCONFIRMED','FAIL',count(*)::int FROM monthly_bills WHERE bill_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','DRAFT') UNION ALL SELECT 'TAX_INVOICE_NO','WARN',count(*)::int FROM monthly_bills WHERE bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND nullif(btrim(txinv_no),'') IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'FIN_ENTRY','WARN',CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM fin.entry WHERE entry_ym=#{month} AND deleted_yn='N' UNION ALL SELECT 'PART_SETTLE','FAIL',count(*)::int FROM operating_parts p WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM fin.part_stlm s WHERE s.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND s.stlm_ym=#{month} AND s.stlm_stts_cd='CONFIRM') UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYMENT','WARN',count(*)::int FROM fin.pay p WHERE p.pay_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','UNPAID') AND p.pay_plan_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.pay c WHERE c.cry_pay_id=p.pay_id AND c.pay_stts_cd!='CANCEL') ) SELECT c.code,CASE WHEN c.count=0 THEN 'OK' ELSE c.severity END AS status,c.count, CASE WHEN c.code='FIN_ENTRY' THEN (SELECT '재무 항목 '||count(*)||'건 · SGA '||coalesce(sum(entry_amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_se_cd='SGA'),0) ||'원 · NOI '||coalesce(sum(entry_amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_se_cd='NOI'),0) ||'원 · NOE '||coalesce(sum(entry_amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_se_cd='NOE'),0)||'원' ||CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN ': 실제 없음인지 확인' ELSE '' END FROM fin.entry WHERE entry_ym=#{month} AND deleted_yn='N') WHEN c.code='SALARY_UPLOAD' THEN (SELECT '급여 대상 '||count(*)||'명 · 미업로드 '||c.count||'명' FROM eligible) WHEN c.code='PART_SETTLE' THEN (SELECT '정산 대상 '||count(*)||'개 · 미확정 '||c.count||'개' FROM operating_parts) WHEN c.count=0 THEN '정상' ELSE '원천 자료를 확인하세요.' END AS description FROM counts c LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl d ON d.cd_grp_id='CLOSE_CHECK' AND d.dtl_cd=c.code ORDER BY d.sort_seq,c.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin.mth_cls_chk(cls_ym,cls_chk_cd,chk_rslt_cd,issue_cnt,msg_desc,chk_user_id,chk_at) VALUES (#{month},#{c.code},#{c.status},#{c.count},#{c.description},#{actor},#{at}) ON CONFLICT(cls_ym,cls_chk_cd) DO UPDATE SET chk_rslt_cd=excluded.chk_rslt_cd,issue_cnt=excluded.issue_cnt, msg_desc=excluded.msg_desc,chk_user_id=excluded.chk_user_id,chk_at=excluded.chk_at
mapper.select: SELECT h.cls_hist_id AS id,h.cls_ym AS month,h.cls_prcs_cd AS action,h.prcs_at AS "processedAt", coalesce(u.user_nm,'시스템 처리') AS actor,h.rsn_desc AS reason FROM fin.mth_cls_hist h LEFT JOIN sys.user_info u ON u.user_id=h.prcs_user_id ORDER BY h.prcs_at DESC,h.cls_hist_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.pl_ym AS month,p.bsn_prft_amt AS profit,p.sls_cst_amt AS cost,t.corp_tax_amt AS tax,b.end_bal_amt AS cash,'[]' AS warnings FROM fin.mth_pl p JOIN fin.corp_tax_mth t ON t.tax_ym=p.pl_ym JOIN fin.cash_bal b ON b.bal_ym=p.pl_ym WHERE p.pl_ym=#{month} AND p.pl_src_cd='CLOSE' AND b.end_bal_amt IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'SGA_ITEM' AS dimension,coalesce(item_cd,'ENTRY-'||entry_id::text) AS code,min(item_nm) AS name, 0::bigint AS revenue,sum(entry_amt)::bigint AS cost,0::bigint AS gross_profit FROM fin.entry WHERE entry_ym=#{month} AND fin_se_cd='SGA' AND deleted_yn='N' GROUP BY coalesce(item_cd,'ENTRY-'||entry_id::text)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin.cash_bal(bal_ym,bgn_bal_amt,end_bal_amt,updated_by,updated_at) VALUES(#{components.month},#{components.opening},#{components.cash},#{actor},#{at}) ON CONFLICT(bal_ym) DO UPDATE SET bgn_bal_amt=excluded.bgn_bal_amt,end_bal_amt=excluded.end_bal_amt,updated_by=excluded.updated_by,updated_at=excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO sys.data_chg_hist(tbl_nm,obj_rec_id,data_chg_ty_cd,clmn_nm,bfr_val,aft_val,rsn_desc,chg_user_id,chg_at) VALUES('fin.mth_cls',#{transition.month},'UPDATE','cls_stts_cd',CASE WHEN #{transition.action}='CLOSE' THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'CLOSED' END,CASE WHEN #{transition.action}='CLOSE' THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE 'OPEN' END,#{transition.reason},#{transition.actor},#{transition.at})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fin.mth_pl WHERE pl_ym=#{month} AND pl_src_cd='CLOSE'
mapper.update: UPDATE fin.cash_bal SET end_bal_amt=NULL WHERE bal_ym=#{month}
